name: Owe & Go
description: Design tokens used by the Version 2 screens only. Values are taken from the V2 design files. Where the design system's Postcard Press theme differs (borders, card shadow), the V2 screens win.

foreground.usage: Default text, icons, dark buttons, your balance amount.

primary.usage: Primary buttons (Save, Settle up on Balances), active tab, selected rings and check badges.

inverse.usage: Dark buttons (Next, Create trip, Settle up on Home, Mark paid, Done) and the floating Add expense button.

muted.usage: Quiet fills: currency chips in lists, selected menu rows, date range band, alert backgrounds, Paid badges.

muted-foreground.usage: Secondary text: dates, meta lines, helper text, original-currency amounts, inactive tabs.

placeholder.usage: Input placeholder text and empty date values.

border.usage: Card borders, dividers, list separators, icon button outlines, unfilled progress segments.

input.usage: Input and grouped field borders, amount underline.

destructive.usage: Validation errors, error borders and labels, rates unavailable icon.

owed.usage: Someone is owed money on Balances; success checks and Paid badges. Always with a + sign and up arrow.

owes.usage: Someone owes money on Balances. Always with a minus sign and down arrow. Your own balance on Home uses foreground instead.

overlay.usage: Backdrop behind bottom sheets. The confirm payment sheet uses rgba(20,20,20,0.4).

mono.usage: Money amounts, currency codes, rates. Always tabular numerals.

title.usage: Flow titles and trip name (Where are you headed?, Who is coming?, Tokyo 2026).

sheet-title.usage: Bottom sheet titles (Select dates, When was it paid?).

section-lg.usage: Settle up heading (3 payments settle the trip).

header.usage: Top bar titles, list item names, person names.

body.usage: Body copy, button labels (15 to 16px, weight 600).

item-title.usage: Expense row titles and payment card titles.

meta.usage: Helper text, meta lines, error messages (13px / 18px).

label.usage: Field labels (What for, Date, Trip name), small headings.

caption.usage: Expense meta on Home, person names under avatars.

amount-input.usage: Paid and home currency amounts on New expense.

amount-each.usage: Each pays amount and Waiting on rate placeholder.

amount-md.usage: Expense list amounts, trip totals (15 to 16px).

page-x.usage: Horizontal page padding on every screen.

top-inset.usage: Space above the top bar for the status area.

top-bar.usage: Top bar height below the inset.

footer-bottom.usage: Bottom padding under footers and sheets.

tab-bar-bottom.usage: Bottom padding under the tab bar.

sm.usage: Menu options, currency chips in Home list.

md.usage: Buttons, list icons, alerts, past trip thumbnails.

xl.usage: Cards, grouped fields, trip photo on Trips.

full.usage: Pills, avatars, icon buttons, search fields, chips, Add expense button.

card.usage: Balance card, primary payment card, destination search, traveler pill, Add expense button.
